response_property_constraints.description: The type field of each top-level data item must equal 'hotel-offers'.
The hotelId must match the pattern ^[A-Z0-9]{8}$ (8 uppercase alphanumeric characters).
The chainCode must match the pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$ (exactly 2 uppercase letters).
The brandCode, when present, must match the pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$ (exactly 2 uppercase letters).
The cityCode must match the pattern ^[A-Z]{3}$ (exactly 3 uppercase letters).
The offer id must match the pattern ^[A-Z0-9]*$ and have a length between 2 and 100 characters.
The checkInDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format and must not be in the past.
The checkOutDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format and must be at least checkInDate+1.
The rateCode must match the pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$ (exactly 3 uppercase alphanumeric or asterisk characters).
The rateFamilyEstimated code must match the pattern [A-Z0-9]{3} (exactly 3 uppercase alphanumeric characters).
The rateFamilyEstimated type must match the pattern [PNC] (one of P, N, or C).
The room type code must match the pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$ (exactly 3 uppercase alphanumeric or asterisk characters).
The number of adult guests per room must be between 1 and 9 inclusive.
Each child age in the childAges array must be between 0 and 20 inclusive.
Each credit card code in the acceptedPayments creditCards array must match the pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$ (exactly 2 uppercase letters).
The paymentType field must be one of the enumerated values: GUARANTEE, DEPOSIT, PREPAY, HOLDTIME, guarantee, deposit, prepay, holdtime.
The boardType field, when present, must be one of the enumerated values defined in the BoardType schema.
The cancellation type, when present, must equal 'FULL_STAY'.
The price variation startDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
The price variation endDate must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format and must be after startDate.
The tax currency code must have a length between 1 and 3 characters.
The numberOfNights in the cancellation policy must be >= 0 when present.
The self link of each offer, when present, must be a valid URL starting with https://.

request_response_constraints.description: Each hotel in the response data must have a hotelId that matches one of the hotelIds provided in the request.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Amadeus property codes on 8 chars. Mandatory parameter for a search by predefined list of hotels.

request_response_constraints.description: The number of adults in each offer's guests object must match the 'adults' request parameter.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Number of adult guests (1-9) per room.

request_response_constraints.description: The checkInDate in each offer must match the 'checkInDate' request parameter when provided.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Check-in date of the stay (hotel local date). Format YYYY-MM-DD.

request_response_constraints.description: The checkOutDate in each offer must match the 'checkOutDate' request parameter when provided.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Check-out date of the stay (hotel local date). Format YYYY-MM-DD. The lowest accepted value is checkInDate+1.

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'boardType' request parameter is provided, every offer in the response must have a boardType equal to that value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Filter response based on available meals.

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'paymentPolicy' request parameter is provided and is not 'NONE', every offer's policies paymentType must match that value (case-insensitive).
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Filter the response based on a specific payment type. NONE means all types (default).

request_response_constraints.description: When the 'includeClosed' request parameter is 'false', all returned hotel entries should have available=true.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Show all properties (include sold out) or available only. For sold out properties, please check availability on other dates.

response_property_constraints.description: The limit field must be a non-negative integer no greater than 50 (per the query parameter constraint).
The offset field must be a non-negative integer.
The total field must be a non-negative integer representing the total number of items available.
The number of items returned must not exceed the limit value in the response.
The total number of items returned plus the offset must not exceed the total available items.
The href field must be a valid URL starting with https://.
The next field must be either null or a valid URL string pointing to the next page of items.
The previous field must be either null or a valid URL string pointing to the previous page of items.
The type field of each track item must be 'track'.
The uri field of each track item must follow the Spotify URI format 'spotify:track:<id>'.
The href field of each track item must be a valid URL starting with 'https://'.
The duration_ms field of each track must be a non-negative integer representing track length in milliseconds.
The disc_number field of each track must be a positive integer (at least 1).
The track_number field of each track must be a positive integer (at least 1).
The preview_url field must be either null or a valid URL string starting with 'https://' or 'http://'.
Each entry in the available_markets array of a track must be a 2-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code string.
Each artist object within a track's artists array must have a type field equal to 'artist'.
Each artist object within a track's artists array must have a uri field following the Spotify URI format 'spotify:artist:<id>'.

request_response_constraints.description: The limit in the response must equal the limit query parameter provided in the request, or the default value of 20 if not provided.

request_response_constraints.description: The offset in the response must equal the offset query parameter provided in the request, or the default value of 0 if not provided.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The index of the first item to return

request_response_constraints.description: The href in the response must contain the offset query parameter value used in the request.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The index of the first item to return

request_response_constraints.description: If the offset plus the number of returned items is less than total, next must be a non-null URL; if offset plus items count equals or exceeds total, next must be null.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The index of the first item to return

request_response_constraints.description: If the offset is 0, previous must be null; if offset is greater than 0, previous must be a non-null URL.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The index of the first item to return

response_property_constraints.description: The 'code' field must be an integer representing the HTTP status code of the returned result (e.g., 200 for success).

The 'count' field in the data container must be a non-negative integer representing the total number of results returned.
Since this endpoint fetches a single comic by id, the count in data must be either 0 or 1.
Since this endpoint fetches a single comic by id, the total in data must be either 0 or 1.
The 'results' array must contain at most 1 comic since this endpoint fetches a single comic by id.

The 'resourceURI' field must be a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.

Each price in the 'prices' array must have a 'price' field that is a non-negative number (all prices in USD).
The thumbnail's 'path' field must be a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
Each image in the 'images' array must have a 'path' field that is a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
In the 'creators' resource list, the 'available' count must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
In the 'characters' resource list, the 'available' count must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
In the 'stories' resource list, the 'available' count must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
In the 'events' resource list, the 'available' count must be greater than or equal to the 'returned' count.
The number of items in the 'characters.items' array must equal the 'characters.returned' value.
The number of items in the 'stories.items' array must equal the 'stories.returned' value.
The number of items in the 'creators.items' array must equal the 'creators.returned' value.
The number of items in the 'events.items' array must equal the 'events.returned' value.
The 'series.resourceURI' field must be a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
Each item in the 'variants' array must have a 'resourceURI' field that is a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.

Each character item in the 'characters.items' array that has a 'resourceURI' field must have it as a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
The 'creators.collectionURI' field must be a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
The 'issueNumber' field must be a non-negative number (generally 0 for collection formats).

Each business's review_count must be a non-negative integer.
Each business's distance, when present, must be a non-negative number.

The number of businesses returned in the response array must not exceed the total field value.

The region center longitude, when present, must be a number between -180 and 180 inclusive.
